identity.name: Alva Care
identity.description: Fictional patient-facing health service used to prove the white-label pipeline on a care brand: appointments, results, messages.
identity.audience: Patients and carers of all ages and digital confidence.
identity.voice: Warm, unhurried, concrete. Never alarming. Explains before it asks.
identity.directives: Large touch targets and generous spacing. Status colours never carry meaning alone; always pair with a label. Avoid red for anything that is not an error.

guidelines:
# Alva Care — Brand Guidelines

## Visual rules
- Blue is the primary action colour; teal marks secondary emphasis; both stay off alerts.
- Fully rounded corners and soft elevation: surfaces feel approachable.
- Prefer one action per screen; secondary actions are text buttons.

## Writing rules
- Sentence case. Short sentences. No medical jargon without a plain-language gloss.
- Tell people what will happen next before asking them to act.
- Times and dates always with timezone when they matter.
